successors.name: Gandhāra
successors.text: the Pakistani view on the page: the graves 'continued in existence from the 8th century BCE until the historic period'

ledger.x: c. 1200 BCE: large graveyards appear in northern Gandhara. Infobox 'c. 1200-800 BCE', type site 'Swat Protohistoric Graveyards Complex', inhumation phase '(c. 1200-900 BCE)' with 'iron technology' introduced. The year is the infobox's; the page's dates of earlier Swat periods (Ghalegay IV c. 1700-1400, V c. 1400-1000)…

c. 800 BCE: the graveyard culture ends. The Italian mission 'holds that there are no burials with these features after 800 BCE'; the Pakistani view is that the graves 'continued in existence from the 8th century BCE until the historic period'. The Gandhara janapada (-600) is the later state of the same valleys.

certainty.note: An archaeological culture known from graveyards at about a dozen named sites; the valleys are the page's, the edges are not.
